summary: Disc Medicine, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a $350 million primary underwritten offering of common stock, with pre-funded warrants offered in lieu of stock to certain investors at the same public price less a $0.0001 exercise price. The last reported sale price on October 19, 2026 was $78.93 per share. Underwriters received a 30-day option for up to $52.5 million additional shares; Jefferies, Leerink Partners, Morgan Stanley and Cantor are joint book-running managers. Terms remain blank pending pricing. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing, discount and dilution.
